# Just Run It

> Production-ready enterprise workload automation control plane: jobs, workflows, schedules, federated agents, and workspaces. Commercial licenses available.

- Site: https://justrunit.io/
- Product demo: https://justrunit.io/#demo
- License contact: justrunit.io@gmail.com
- Phone: 318-232-2280 (leave a message; we will call back)
- Product GitHub (platform): https://github.com/justrunit-io/automation-platform
- Website source: https://github.com/justrunit-io/justrunit-website

## Positioning

- Commercial production software available for license now
- Strengths: run work where files live, multi-team workspaces, RBAC/OIDC, HA deploy paths
- Not a public roadmap or gap analysis site — customer materials describe shipped capabilities

## Key capabilities

- Job types: COMMAND (shell), HTTP, NOOP, GIT_RELEASE. A command succeeds on exit code 0. A job can be turned off to stop new runs
- Workflows with conditions and restart from failed step
- Cron schedules for jobs or workflows
- Out-of-process agents on Linux and Windows (pull model). A workspace agent pool, or a preferred agent for one host
- On Linux the agent refuses to start as root. The command has that account's rights
- Remote agents use HTTPS and a short-lived identity-provider token. HTTP Basic remains for a private network
- Personal, group, and platform workspaces
- RBAC: VIEWER is read-only even as a workspace owner. OPERATOR runs and edits managed workspaces. ADMIN governs users, groups, deletes, and the definition file
- Audit: who changed a job, workflow, or schedule, when, and the fields before and after
- Administrators export jobs, workflows, and schedules, review adds, updates, and removals, and apply only confirmed lines. History and hostnames stay out of the file
- The API catalog is for administrators. Operators and agents call the API. Viewers do not
- Execution triage: history, logs, cancel/kill, orphan recovery. Agent load is the work actually running
- Deploy: Docker Compose HA, Helm/Kubernetes, bare metal/VM; JAR for sandbox
